content.short: DNA is a community token on World Chain that rewards human contribution, with its own wallet and apps.
content.description: DNA Token is a community-driven token on World Chain that rewards users for daily participation, with staking, an NFT marketplace (GenomeX) and a DNA Wallet, all running as mini apps in World App. It reports more than 670,000 registered users. DefiLlama tracks DNA on World Chain.
